findings.evidence: Tate.lean:41,49 use plusSubring and its membership API from Plus.lean; neither proof uses the PerfectRing import or subsequent Tate construction.
findings.fix: Move both declarations to UniformTilt/Plus.lean near the integral-tilt membership results.
findings.issue: isOpen_plusSubring and isBounded_plusSubring describe the integral tilt independently of the compatible-pseudouniformiser criterion, but are unavailable from its canonical module.

findings.evidence: Tate.lean:73,88 use only basic coordinate operations and topology; Basic.lean already supplies coeff_pow_p at 644, coeff_pow_p_pow at 653, tendsto_nhds_iff at 816, and continuous_coeff at 829.
findings.fix: Move both declarations to UniformTilt/Basic.lean alongside the coordinate and topology API.
findings.issue: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_coeff_zero and isUnit_iff_coeff_zero are basic coordinate properties unnecessarily placed behind the integral-tilt and perfectoid dependencies.

summary: Four supporting declarations belong in earlier UniformTilt modules, so users can access them without importing the Tate/perfectoid layer.
